row: GRG Ranch is a 501c-3 Equine Nonprofit horse rescue, sanctuary, and therapeutic riding facility. We also offer able bodied lessons and horse training both on and off site. Our mission is to give every horse and human the opportunity to heal and to provide quality care to our permanent herd and horses as they transition through rescue and rehabilitation in search of their new lives. Learn more about GRG Ranch and our family, big and small, at www.grgranch.org
